messages:
Maya: hey all — trying to join the orientation tomorrow 9:00am but my calendar shows 9:00 UTC? Zoom asks for passcode too. I'm in IST (UTC+5:30). Which invite should I follow? is recording on? thanks :wave:
Sam (People Ops): hey Maya — sorry for the confusion. There were two invites created (Americas & Global). Please accept the 'Orientation — Global' invite; that's the canonical one and has recording enabled. I just removed the duplicate Americas-only event. :thumbsup:
Maya: thanks! i only see 'Orientation' and an 'Orientation (Americas)' one — where is Global? i use Outlook.
Alex (IT): Outlook sometimes shows the timezone-encoded ICS as UTC. Try opening the event and check 'Show time zone' or re-add by clicking the 'Add to calendar' link in the onboarding email. If that doesn't work, open the ICS file and ensure DTSTART/DTEND lines have TZID set to your zone. If you want I can re-send the single-event ICS.
Priya (Onboarding): Re-sent the single 'Orientation — Global' invite (check email). Also added a note in the event description with the recording policy and APAC repeat signup form: https://redwood.com/onboarding/recordings and https://redwood.com/onboarding/apac-repeat
Maya: got it, email received. zoom still asks for passcode — where to find it?
Sam (People Ops): passcode is in the event description under 'Zoom link & passcode'. If it's blank for you, try the calendar web view (sometimes mobile truncates long descriptions). If you still can't see it, DM me and I can paste it.
Alex (IT): if anyone on Outlook sees the event time wrong, try this quick fix:
```
1. Open event -> More actions -> Edit
2. Click Time zone dropdown -> set to your local zone
3. Save
```
Priya (Onboarding): Recording will be uploaded to the orientation folder and OnboardBot will post the link in #new-hires when ready.
OnboardBot: Recording uploaded: https://redwood.com/onboarding/recordings/1971234567-orientation.mp4 (transcript & captions available)
Maya: perfect — thanks all! can i get the APAC repeat link? i'm in IST and 9am PT is late for me.
Priya (Onboarding): APAC-friendly repeat signup: https://redwood.com/onboarding/signup-apac — we usually run one at 7pm IST. :blush:
Sam (People Ops): also, if anyone is blocked by corporate SSO/Zoom passcode prompts, reach out to Alex and we'll whitelist the SSO redirect.
Alex (IT): noted. I can also re-provision an ICS without passcode embedded if that helps.
Maya: that's ideal, thanks :heart
Sam (People Ops): ok closing the loop — 'Orientation — Global' is canonical; passcode in description; recording will be posted; APAC repeat sign-up link sent. Ping here if still confused. :v:
